_common: Pixel art game effect for a top-down 3/4-view monster battle game. Small: fits a 48x48 pixel canvas, centered, transparent background, crisp pixels with a dark outline where it helps readability, bright saturated colours. One-shot (not looping), about {n} frames, ends fully faded out.
normal: a white-and-pale-yellow impact burst: a quick star-shaped flash with a few short sparks flying outward
fighting: a punch impact: orange-red fist-shaped shock burst with radiating speed lines
crit: a critical hit: a big golden-white star flash with sharp spikes and sparkles, stronger than a normal hit
fire: a fire hit: a burst of orange and yellow flames that flare up and flicker out into small embers and smoke
water: a water hit: a blue splash bursting outward with droplets falling
ice: an ice hit: pale cyan ice shards crack out from the centre and shatter into glittering frost
elec: an electric hit: yellow lightning bolts zigzag outward from a bright white core, crackling
grass: a grass hit: green leaves burst out and spin away
poison: a poison hit: purple toxic bubbles and sludge burst out and pop
ground: a ground hit: brown dirt and pebbles burst up from the ground with a dust cloud
rock: a rock hit: grey rock chunks smash and fly outward with dust
ghost: a ghost hit: dark purple wisps and a ghostly face-like swirl that fades
psychic: a psychic hit: pink-magenta concentric rings ripple out with sparkles
dragon: a dragon hit: indigo and violet draconic energy flare with a fang-like slash
wind: a wind hit: pale green-white gusts swirling in curved lines
bug: a bug hit: lime-green little stingers and a buzzing swarm burst
boom: an explosion: a round orange-yellow fireball blast that expands with smoke and debris, then dissipates
heal: a healing effect: soft green sparkles and plus signs rising upward with a gentle glow
buff: a stat-up effect: orange upward arrows and glow rising around the centre
slash: a single fast white sword-slash arc, diagonal, with a thin trailing afterimage
claw: three parallel claw-scratch marks slashing diagonally, white with red edges
dash: a dash dust trail: puffs of dust and speed lines streaking horizontally
charge: a charging-up effect: energy particles converge inward to a glowing centre that brightens
flamer: a cone of flamethrower fire pointing right, roaring orange-yellow flames
blizzard: a cold blizzard gust: swirling snowflakes and ice wind pointing right
magicshot: a magic projectile: a glowing purple-white orb with a short sparkling trail
aoe_fire: a circular area fire eruption on the ground: a ring of flames bursting up
aoe_ground: a circular earthquake: cracked ground ring with rocks bursting up
aoe_elec: a circular electric field: lightning arcs crackling across a ring on the ground
aoe_water: a circular water geyser: water bursting up in a ring and splashing down
aoe_ice: a circular frost burst: ice spikes rising in a ring then shattering
aoe_psychic: a circular psychic wave: pink rings expanding across the ground
aoe_ghost: a circular shadow pool: dark purple hands and wisps rising from the ground in a ring
shockwave: a shockwave: a white expanding ring of air pressure with dust
slam: a heavy body slam: ground impact crater with dust ring and cracks
aoe_grass: a circular burst of thorny vines and leaves sprouting from the ground
aoe_poison: a circular toxic cloud: purple gas puffing outward in a ring
st_fire: a big fire pillar erupting upward from the ground
st_rock: stone pillars erupting upward from the ground
st_ice: a large ice crystal growing upward from the ground then shattering
st_psychic: a pink psychic pillar of light beaming upward
st_ghost: a dark ghostly hand reaching up from the ground
st_ground: a burst of earth: a mound of dirt bursting up from below
st_dragon: a violet dragon-shaped energy pillar surging upward
barrier: a protective barrier: a translucent light-blue hexagon shield bubble that flashes and fades
curse: a curse: dark purple-black smoke with a glowing red eye-like rune
counter: a counter stance flash: a white-blue parry spark with crossed lines
timestop: a time-stop effect: a pale clock-face ring with ticking hands, greyish-blue
speed: a speed-up effect: blue-white speed lines and wind swirling upward
debuff: a stat-down effect: blue downward arrows sinking
par: a paralysis effect: small yellow electric sparks crackling around the centre
freeze: a frozen effect: ice crystals forming and frost covering
sleep: a sleep effect: floating Zzz letters and soft blue bubbles
psn: a poisoned effect: purple bubbles rising and popping
summon: a summoning circle: a glowing magic circle on the ground with rising light
teleport: a teleport effect: a vertical beam of light with sparkles that vanishes
ko: a knockout effect: a burst of white stars and a puff, then fade
confetti: colourful confetti and streamers popping out
floor_fire: fire burning on the ground, a patch of small flames flickering
floor_poison: a bubbling purple poison puddle on the ground
floor_elec: an electrified floor patch with small crackling sparks
floor_ground: a patch of cracked shaking ground with small pebbles bouncing
